why_best: This approach pairs tactile print-making energy with digital layout controls to give simple dynamic copy cuts an urgent, highly stylised rhythm.
why_bad: A standard three-dimensional camera movement would ruin the beat because scaling both axes proportionally removes the graphic tension created by squishing text horizontally and vertically on independent passes.
trap: Treating the scale changes like a uniform camera lens push rather than distorting the letterforms across isolated horizontal and vertical axes.
